Hi Olivia — thanks for surfacing these. I’m Rishi (Applied ML / Security interface) — copying Marissa for onboarding context. Short answers up front, followed by a few clarifications.

Short answers: 
• SOC 2: Attached is a redacted copy of our SOC 2 Type II (SOC2_Redwood_2025_TypeII_redacted.pdf).
• BAA: We have a standard BAA (attached: Redwood_BAA_draft_2026.docx). We can negotiate specific clauses; our legal team is used to typical provider edits.
• Deployment eligibility for PHI: Dedicated and Private deployments are fully supported for PHI (we can execute a BAA and enable customer-controlled networking and key management). Hosted API is available for general workloads but by default is not approved for PHI ingestion unless a bespoke enterprise contract and additional controls are put in place (we typically recommend Dedicated or Private for PHI).
• PHI flow & persistence: inference requests are routed through our runtime. By default we:
   - do not persist input/output tokens to long-term storage; ephemeral KV cache is kept in-memory on the serving nodes and is evicted according to session policies
   - operational logs are scrubbed for PII/PHI by default; we provide options to disable logging or to route logs to a customer-managed destination for audit purposes
   - metrics are aggregated and do not contain raw request text unless explicitly enabled for troubleshooting

Clarifying Qs we’d like from BrightHealth before the call:
1) Expected traffic profile (rps, average token length) so we can size Dedicated pools for throughput and cost guidance.
2) Which PHI classes will be transmitted (structured identifiers, free-text notes, images).
3) Any retention or eDiscovery requirements beyond standard log retention.

Attachments: I’ve attached the SOC2 and BAA for your legal/security review. I’ll prepare answers in your questionnaire and upload the completed spreadsheet to the Drive link (we’ll also mark any redactions).

If BrightHealth is open to a fast path: we can provision a short-term Dedicated sandbox (isolated tenant) for a POC while contractual work proceeds — that’s often helpful for security teams to validate controls without full production commitment.

Happy to set a 30-minute call — Mateo, can you share the suggested windows?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
